metadata.name: backend-engineering
metadata.description: Design, implement, extend, debug, optimize, review, or migrate backend services and their data and operating paths. Use for APIs and CRUD, authentication and tenant authorization, databases, workers, integrations, network/TLS failures, capacity, deployment, observability and recovery. Exclude frontend-only work, unrelated writing, and backend terms used incidentally.

method: 12 separate fresh fork_turns=none contexts, same inherited model/settings; each received metadata and one prompt without expected label, no tools and no implementation request.
